# Parser fixtures

`cc-cedict.mdx` is a small-project compatibility fixture derived from the
CC-CEDICT open dictionary distributed by Medict's upstream test/preset data.
CC-CEDICT is attributed to MDBG and distributed under the Creative Commons
Attribution-ShareAlike 3.0 license. See <https://www.mdbg.net/chinese/dictionary?page=cc-cedict>
for the source and license terms.

The fixture is used only to verify the public exact-lookup seam. It is not a
bundled user dictionary and does not define the product's supported content.
